newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: B'desh taka ends weaker in dull new year session.
newsitem.headline: B'desh taka ends weaker in dull new year session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended weaker at 42.5400/5430 against a previous 42.4370/5400 to the dollar in dull interbank trading on Wednesday as all major international markets were closed for New Year holiday, dealers said.
"There was virtually no activity. Everyone was rather busy to exchange (new year) greetings. There were very few deals," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended flat at 6.0-6.5 percent, dealers said.
